title: What Do You Mean? Exploring How Humans and AI Interact with Symbols and Meanings in Their Interactions
reasoning: The paper focuses on the co-construction of meaning and symbols between humans and AI based on Symbolic Interactionism theory. While it contains a brief 'Ethical Considerations' section and one participant mention of religious beliefs as a personal context for a preference, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
